title: Room climate of an area
description: Which entities of the area give its room temperature and humidity (docs/room-climate.md). The hub decides with what only it knows (registry entity_category, device name and model, the device's Home Assistant area); the apps compute the value from the live states. source admin: the one entity the admin picked (no value while it has none). source auto: the median of the entities of the measure's device_domains that report device_attribute, else the median of the sensors with a numeric state (data/room-climate.json). Absent (older hub, direct mode, demo): the apps apply the same rule to the area's visible placements with what they know (entity_id, names, device_class).
